subject: Hosted API sandbox + short eval — timezone-sensitive slot request
messages:
From: Carl Lee <carl.lee@fastlyte.com>
To: trials@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Self-serve sandbox: Hosted API eval request

Hi Redwood team,

I spun up an account via the self-serve flow and kicked the Hosted API sandbox a bit this morning. We're evaluating inference for a customer-facing summarization feature and I'd like a short walkthrough of best practices — especially batching, caching, and token-cost tradeoffs. Our CTO (Sanjay) may join but his schedule is tight.

Quick context: 50k monthly active users expected in Q4, latency targets ~150ms for short prompts. We have a small budget for a pilot and want to try the sandbox + a 30-min technical demo before committing to a Dedicated eval.

Could someone from the team propose a couple of 30-min windows? We're in London (BST).

Thanks,
Carl Lee
Head of Product
FastLyte, Inc.
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Carl Lee <carl.lee@fastlyte.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve sandbox: Hosted API eval request

Hi Carl — thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Diego from SDR; looping in Rishi (AE) to run the short walkthrough.

We have a couple of slots that should match your BST availability — please pick one that works, or tell us a preferred afternoon slot and we'll do our best to accommodate:
- Tue Jun 30, 16:00 BST / 11:00 ET (30 min) — https://cal.redwood.com/rishi/30min
- Wed Jul 1, 14:30 BST / 09:30 ET (30 min) — https://cal.redwood.com/rishi/30min

I've attached a very short "sandbox-instructions.pdf" with test prompts and an API-key expiration note so you can exercise the Hosted API before the call. Also included is a quick checklist for things Rishi may demo (batching, KV cache tips, simple quantization notes).

If those windows don't work, reply with two times that fit your CTO and we can try to reshuffle.

Thanks — we'll keep the session tight and hands-on.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
SDR, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: sandbox-instructions.pdf)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Carl Lee <carl.lee@fastlyte.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Self-serve sandbox: Hosted API eval request

On Mon, Jun 29, 2026 at 09:35 AM PDT Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Carl — thanks for signing up and for the details. I'm Diego from SDR; looping in Rishi (AE) to run the short walkthrough.

Thanks Carl — Rishi here. I'll keep this to 30 minutes and focus on concrete runbook items for pilot success:
- Quick repo of the sample prompts and prompt-windowing tactics (I attached demo-agenda.md).
- Live walk through the Hosted API latency profile and cost levers (batching settings, prefix caching).
- A short Q&A about rollout strategies (canary, fallback to smaller model).

If your CTO can join, great; if not, we'll demo for the engineers and record the session.

Two small asks before the call to keep it practical: could you (or your engineer)
1) paste 2–3 representative prompts you plan to run against the model, and
2) confirm whether you will want the API key to be time-limited (30 days) or indefinite for the pilot.

I've kept the two proposed windows from Diego. If neither works for an afternoon BST slot with your CTO, tell me a pair of preferred European afternoon times and we'll propose a backfill.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
demo-agenda.md (attached)
From: Carl Lee <carl.lee@fastlyte.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:42:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Self-serve sandbox: Hosted API eval request

Thanks, Diego and Rishi — appreciate the quick follow-ups.

Quick update: our CTO can join but only after 15:00 BST on Tue/Wed this week. The two links you sent are showing ET-centric times for us and the 16:00 BST slot from Tue conflicts with an existing leadership review. Can we move the demo to Tue Jun 30 at 16:30 BST or Wed Jul 1 at 15:30 BST?

Also: our engineer will share the sample prompts shortly. For the pilot we'll prefer a time-limited API key (30 days).

If it's easier, send a direct calendar invite for the confirmed time (we're on Google Calendar). Also please attach the sandbox-instructions.pdf again — I couldn't find it in the trial onboarding email.

Thanks,
Carl
Head of Product, FastLyte
